page_name: Zodiac Series - Rabbit Postcards (set of 2 Designs) (PCRBTPCD)
description:
The Chinese calendar is based on five cycles of 12 years each, with each cycle tempered by one of the five Chinese elements – Metal, Wood, Water, Fire and Earth. Each year features one of the 12 animal signs, and the year of 2023 is that of the Water Rabbit.


The year 2023 marks the reign of the Rabbit and the fourth animal in the Zodiac series on the Chinese calendar. This warm, responsible and patient Rabbit is depicted on this set of stamps (1st Local and $1.50).
